    2. Split into tokens based on whitespace.
    3. Strip leading/trailing punctuation from each token.
    4. Count the tokens.

    tokens_raw = text.lower().split()

    cleaned_tokens = []

        cleaned_token = token.strip(string.punctuation)
        if cleaned_token:
            cleaned_tokens.append(cleaned_token)
